 Paraguay: Tax authority extends November VAT deadlines
 Paraguay: Tax authority extends November VAT deadlines
 Home » VAT Updates 
 On 9 November 2026, Paraguay’s National Directorate of Tax Revenues (DNIT) issued General Resolution No. 60/2026, extending November filing and payment deadlines for VAT, corporate income tax (IRE), individual income tax (IRP) and selective consumption tax (ISC).
 Revised filing and payment deadlines
 The DNIT has introduced new deadlines based on the final digit of each taxpayer’s Single Taxpayer Registry (RUC) number.
 The extensions range from 9 to 16 November 2026 for RUC numbers ending in zero or one, and from 25 to 26 November 2026 for numbers ending in nine.
 The revised deadlines do not apply to informational tax returns, withholding tax declarations and payments, or specified instalment payments.
 Penalty relief for affected taxpayers
 Taxpayers who could not meet their November obligations because they could not access funds held at a specified bank may request penalty relief on grounds of force majeure.
 The DNIT has set 4 December 2026 as the deadline for submitting these requests.
 Tax compliance certificates
 The resolution also allows taxpayers with pending or approved bank-related relief requests to obtain tax compliance certificates until 29 January 2027.
